exposure: generalized seizures in the third trimester
finding: The rate of Cesarean section in women with epilepsy was higher than the general population and increased over the 20-year study period, with generalized seizures in the third trimester being the strongest predictor.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section (CS) in women with epilepsy was higher than in the general population, with generalized seizures in the third trimester increasing the likelihood of CS.
